title: Import guide in Settings and a feedback inbox for admins
summary: Open the workout CSV guide from Settings. Administrators see new feedback on their profile picture and can resolve it in the admin console.
changes: Settings > Workout data now has a Show guide button beside the CSV import and export actions. It opens the same three-page guide used during onboarding, including the CSV template and file chooser.

Administrators see unresolved feedback in the badge on their profile picture on Today, alongside follow requests. Profile links to the admin console, where each message has Resolve and Reopen buttons and the App feedback card counts open messages.

image.alt: Workout data in Settings with the Show guide button beside the CSV import and export actions.
